name: Miyamura Miku
source:
The younger of the Miyamura sisters.

A childhood friend and classmate of the protagonist.

She brightens up when surrounded by people, and is cheerful, kind, and caring.

She’s easy to mistake for the protagonist’s girlfriend since they’re always together.

Because she likes being pampered and speaks/acts childishly, the protagonist tends to treat her like a little sister.

She especially likes writing novels and uploads her work to online submission sites.

She keeps this secret from everyone except the protagonist because she fears negative reviews.

After learning her sister Karin is an eroge voice actress, this becomes the trigger for her accepting the request to help with eroge scenario writing.
